{{Quote|Jedi Lowbacca was wondering about the connection between these fine Bururru religious panels and Abeloth. I'm sorry to say he has no appreciation of art for its own sake. He seems convinced that everything you show us should have some connection to Abeloth or the Celestials.|C-3PO|<ref name="FOTJ:A" />}}
The '''Bururru religious panels''' were a set of panels that adorned a corridor wall in the [[Celestial Palace]] of the [[Thuruht]] [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] hive. They depicted the family of [[The Ones/Legends|the Ones]] living in isolation on a [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Abeloth's planet|world]].<ref name="FOTJ:A" />

[[File:TheOnes-SWE.png|thumb|right|300px|The Bururru religious panels depicted the Ones.]]
One depicted a smiling [[Daughter/Legends|Daughter]], running through a forest, followed by clouds of [[Butterfly/Legends|butterflies]] and swarms of Killiks. The next panel depicted the [[Son/Legends|Son]], crushing a [[Toad/Legends|toad]] beneath his boot, while marching through a lifeless forest with a line of Killiks chained behind him. A third panel depicted a high [[Unidentified mountain peak (Abeloth's planet)|mountain peak]] that loomed over both forests, with the barren forest lying to the left side of a dividing [[Unidentified river (Abeloth's planet)|river]] and the forest in bloom to the right. The [[Father (Mortis)/Legends|Father]] was looking out over the scene from the balcony of a cliffside [[Unidentified monastery (Abeloth's planet)|monastery]], his arms spread so that one hand was suspended above the dark aspect of the forest and one over the luminous aspect. The Father's face had an expression of weariness and sorrow, weighed down by a burden as mysterious as it was ancient.<ref name="FOTJ:A" />
